generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
pageNotFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
pageCrashed: This page could not be shown
pageCrashedBody: Something went wrong. You can try again or go back to Home.

code.account_deleted: The account is deleted: it no longer changes.
code.account_invited: An invited account is not changed this way: resend the invitation, give it a temporary password or withdraw it.
code.already_extended: The law allows one extension only, and it was used.
code.already_saved: This selection is already in your picks.
code.bad_key: This browser can't receive PrediGol's notices.
code.bad_minutes: Choose 15 minutes, 30 minutes or 1 hour before.
code.cannot_delete_admin: An administrator account is not deleted: change its role first.
code.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
code.cannot_disable_self: You cannot disable your own account.
code.confirmation_mismatch: The e-mail typed is not the account's.
code.consent_required: To go on, accept the current texts.
code.csrf: Request refused for security reasons. Reload the page.
code.daily_limit: You already did it 3 times today. Try again tomorrow.
code.email_taken: An account with that email already exists.
code.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to do this.
code.idempotency_conflict: That payment was recorded for another account: open the form again.
code.identity_required: Confirm it is you with your password or a code from your app.
code.invalid_amount: Type an amount greater than zero, like 50000 or 19.90.
code.invalid_channel: Choose how the answer was given.
code.invalid_context: We could not attach the screen's context. Please try again.
code.invalid_currency: Type a three-letter currency, like COP or USD.
code.invalid_days: A number of days outside what is allowed.
code.invalid_display_name: The name must be 1 to 80 characters.
code.invalid_idempotency_key: The payment could not be recorded: open the form again.
code.invalid_message: Write a message of up to 4,000 characters.
code.invalid_method: Choose a payment method from the list.
code.invalid_reason: The reason must be 3 to 200 characters long.
code.invalid_selection: That is not a selection we settle.
code.invalid_timezone: That time zone is not valid.
code.last_super_admin: You cannot leave the platform without an active SUPER_ADMIN.
code.legal_text_changed: The text changed while you were reading it: look at the new version.
code.membership_expired: Your membership has ended: renew it to keep using PrediGol.
code.membership_suspended: Your account is suspended: write to us.
code.mfa_enrollment_required: Your account must turn on two-step verification.
code.mfa_required_by_policy: Your account must use two-step verification: it cannot be turned off.
code.mfa_unavailable: Two-step verification is not available on the server right now. Tell the administrator.
code.no_device: You don't receive notices on any device yet: turn them on first.
code.not_available: This is not available for now.
code.not_closed: The question comes once the message is closed.
code.not_editable: It can only be changed before the match starts.
code.not_invited: The account is no longer waiting to be activated.
code.not_removable: It can only be removed before the match starts.
code.not_withdrawable: This is not withdrawn: it ends with the account. To close it, ask for your data to be deleted.
code.password_change_required: Choose your own password before continuing.
code.privacy_request: It is a privacy request: it is answered with its legal rules.
code.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a few seconds.
code.reason_required: Say why in a few words.
code.reference_has_number: No account or card numbers in the reference: a few words or the last 4 digits are enough.
code.request_open: You already have an open request of this kind: we answer it within its deadline.
code.started: The match has started: it can no longer be changed.
code.thread_full: This message is already very long: write us a new one.
code.ticket_closed: This message is closed: write us a new one.
code.too_far: You can set the reminder from 7 days before the match.
code.too_many_alerts: You already have 30 match reminders: remove one to set another.
code.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait {wait} and try again.
code.too_many_links: Three links were already sent to this account in the last hour. Wait a little.
code.too_many_open: You already have 3 open messages: add what is new to one of them.
code.too_many_tests: You already sent 3 test notices today: try again tomorrow.
code.too_many_tickets: You have written many messages today. Try tomorrow or write to us on WhatsApp.
code.trial_used: This account has had its trial already.
code.unknown_category: Choose what your message is about.
code.unknown_pick: That PrediGol pick is not available to your account.
code.unknown_push_service: This browser can't receive PrediGol's notices.
code.unknown_request: That kind of request does not exist.
code.use_privacy_request: Your personal data goes through “Privacy and data”, with its legal deadline.
code.validation_error: Some of the data is not valid.
code.weak_password: The new password is not strong enough.
code.wrong_password: The current password is not right.
code.wrong_stage: That step no longer applies. Reload the page.
code.not_offered: The weekly summary is not available right now.

problem.password_too_short: At least 15 characters, or 12 if you use two-step verification.
problem.password_edge_whitespace: No spaces at the start or the end.
problem.password_too_simple: Use a wider mix of characters.
problem.password_reused: It must differ from the current one.
problem.password_has_context: Do not use your e-mail, your name or “predigol”.
problem.password_common: It is one of the most used passwords: choose another.
